note: The Firebase web config for this project, committed on purpose.
This is the public half of Firebase and it is not a secret: it names the
project and nothing more. Every web app that uses Firebase ships exactly
these values in its JavaScript bundle, and what protects the data is the
Security Rules plus Authentication, never the obscurity of this file.
It is here so that whoever clones this repository talks to the same
project, with the same products and the same accounts, instead of having
to stand up a Firebase project of their own to see the app work.
The private half — the service-account key that lets a server bypass the
rules — is NOT here and never will be. See GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* in the environment overrides every value below.
